capabilities.name: Artifact provenance record schema
capabilities.description: A versioned JSON Schema describes artifact digest, source commit, SBOM reference, and signature state.
limitations: Schema validation does not verify signatures, artifact contents, publisher identity, or SBOM correctness.

capabilities.name: Dependency-free record validator
capabilities.description: A Python validator checks core fields, digest and commit syntax, HTTPS references, and signature-state consistency.
limitations: Validation is structural and does not perform cryptography, network retrieval, scanning, or policy enforcement.

capabilities.name: SBOM generation
capabilities.description: Generate SPDX or CycloneDX SBOMs from reproducible build inputs and artifacts.
limitations: No SBOM generation implementation is present.

capabilities.name: Cryptographic signature verification
capabilities.description: Verify artifact and provenance signatures against explicit trust roots and identity policy.
limitations: No cryptographic signature verification implementation is present.

explicit_non_capabilities: Release signing or trusted key management
Execution of untrusted build or package scripts
